items.source: Alias for origins().
items.translation: `origins()` 的别名。

items.source: Both Spring Web MVC and Spring WebFlux support this annotation through the RequestMappingHandlerMapping in their respective modules. The values from each type and method level pair of annotations are added to a CorsConfiguration and then default values are applied via CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues().
items.translation: Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 均通过各自模块中的RequestMappingHandlerMapping支持此注解。每种类型和方法级别的注解对的值会被添加到CorsConfiguration中，然后通过CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues()应用默认值。

items.source: The rules for combining global and local configuration are generally additive -- for example, all global and all local origins. For those attributes where only a single value can be accepted such as allowCredentials and maxAge, the local overrides the global value. See CorsConfiguration.combine(CorsConfiguration) for more details.
items.translation: 全局和本地配置的合并规则通常是累加的——例如，所有全局和本地的源。对于只能接受单个值的属性（如 `allowCredentials` 和 `maxAge`），本地配置会覆盖全局值。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 CorsConfiguration.combine(CorsConfiguration)。

items.source: By default all origins are allowed unless originPatterns() is also set in which case originPatterns is used instead.
items.translation: 默认情况下，允许所有源，除非也设置了originPatterns()，在这种情况下将使用originPatterns。

items.source: NOTE: Be aware that this option establishes a high level of trust with the configured domains and also increases the surface attack of the web application by exposing sensitive user-specific information such as cookies and CSRF tokens.
items.translation: 注意： 请注意，此选项会与配置的域建立高度信任关系，同时也会增加 Web 应用程序的攻击面，因为它会暴露敏感的用户特定信息（如 Cookie 和 CSRF 令牌）。

items.source: By default this is not set in which case the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header is also not set and credentials are therefore not allowed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置，此时`Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` 响应头也未设置，因此不允许使用凭据。

items.source: This property controls the value of the Access-Control-Max-Age response header of preflight requests.
items.translation: 此属性控制预检请求的 `Access-Control-Max-Age` 响应头的值。

items.source: Setting this to a reasonable value can reduce the number of preflight request/response interactions required by the browser. A negative value means undefined.
items.translation: 将此设置为合理的值可以减少浏览器所需的预检请求/响应交互次数。负值表示未定义。

items.source: By default this is set to 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为1800秒（30 分钟）。

items.source: By default all requested headers are allowed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，允许所有请求的标头。

items.source: By default no headers are listed as exposed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，不列出任何暴露的标头。

items.source:
By default the supported methods are the same as the ones to which a
controller method is mapped.
items.translation: 默认情况下，支持的方法与控制器方法映射到的方法相同。

items.source: By default this is not set (i.e. private network access is not supported).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置（即不支持私有网络访问）。

items.source: Alternative to origins() that supports more flexible origin patterns.
items.translation: 支持更灵活源模式的 `origins()` 的替代方案。

items.source: Russell Allen, Sebastien Deleuze, Sam Brannen, Ruslan Akhundov
items.translation: Russell Allen，Sebastien Deleuze，Sam Brannen，Ruslan Akhundov

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: The list of request headers that are permitted in actual requests, possibly "*" to allow all headers.
items.translation: 实际请求中允许的请求头列表，可能包含 `"*"` 以允许所有请求头。

items.source: The List of response headers that the user-agent will allow the client to access on an actual response, possibly "*" to expose all headers.
items.translation: 用户代理允许客户端在真实响应中访问的响应头列表，可能包含 `"*"` 以暴露所有头。

items.source:
Whether the browser should send credentials, such as cookies along with
cross domain requests, to the annotated endpoint.
items.translation: 浏览器是否应将凭证（例如 Cookie）连同跨域请求一起发送到已注解的端点。

items.source: Whether private network access is supported.
items.translation: 是否支持私有网络访问。

items.source: The maximum age (in seconds) of the cache duration for preflight responses.
items.translation: 预检响应缓存持续时间的最大年龄（以秒为单位）。

items.source: The list of supported HTTP request methods.
items.translation: 支持的 HTTP 请求方法列表。

items.source: A list of origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed.
items.translation: 允许跨域请求的源列表。

items.translation: 可选元素摘要
